pages.title: Stellar Core
pages.text: A captive star the size of a fist, ignited and held together by magnetic confinement. Hydrogen fuses in its heart, and it radiates heat and light as any star does, only smaller. It is impossibly bright and cannot be looked at directly for long.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Stellar Plasma Crucible, I poured Quark-Gluon Plasma around an existing core, and it lit a second fire next to the first. The original was ignited by a white hole fragment, as the old entries say.

Made in $(item)Stellar Plasma Crucible$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Plasma Metallurgy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Closed Timelike Curve, Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Cosmic String Segment, Dark Energy, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Dimensional Residue, Dyson Array, Einstein Field Core and more.
